method: Independent ASR of delivered MP3s, no authored-text prompt; punctuation/case/apostrophe and 20-to-twenty normalization only. Automated proxy, not human listening acceptance.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.authoredText: The plant stayed on. The workers were meant to leave. Find the line that changed before you ask me to put my name under yours.
lines.transcription: The plant stayed on. The workers were meant to leave. Find the line that changed before you ask me to put my name under yours.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.authoredText: You have made one column answer for another. Look again. I am not asking you to believe me; I am asking you to read what is there.
lines.transcription: You have made one column answer for another. Look again. I am not asking you to believe me. I am asking you to read what is there. . . . . . . .

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.authoredText: If you want the hand behind the instruction, bring the cancellation to its key. Her approval is a different act.
lines.transcription: If you want the hand behind the instruction, bring the cancellation to its key. Her approval is a different act.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.authoredText: Ask for the movement page. Leave the families out of the request. I can help you carry a record; I will not give you people to lean on.
lines.transcription: Ask for the movement page. Leave the families out of the request. I can help you carry a record. I will not give you people to lean on.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.authoredText: Keep the question beside the answer you actually brought back. I still have to work here tomorrow.
lines.transcription: Keep the question beside the answer you actually brought back. I still have to work here tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.authoredText: There is the case. There is no name in their register. We kept the bargain. The fitting is another day's work.
lines.transcription: There is the case. There is no name in their register. We kept the bargain. The fitting is another day's work.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.authoredText: I can count what arrived. I can read what they kept. We are not going to make one of those disappear by talking about the other.
lines.transcription: I can count what arrived. I can read what they kept. We are not going to make one of those disappear by talking about the other."

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.authoredText: You stopped before the journey. We can leave it here. The case is still there, and neither of us will call it collected.
lines.transcription: You stopped before the journey. We can leave it here. The case is still there, and neither of us will call it collected.

lines.speaker: Kerr
lines.authoredText: You want me to pay for the quiet way in. Fine. Put something of yours on the counter.
lines.transcription: You want me to pay for the quiet way in. Fine, put something of yours on the counter. . . . . . .
